scoring_justification: The Bethe-Peierls equations (13)-(14) and their integer coefficient tables (Tables I and II) are fully specified, enabling the checker to recompute the reduced Curie temperature and molecular-field ratio from scratch for any exchange parameter set, entirely independent of the agent's implementation.

outputs.description: Parameter scan of the reduced Curie temperature and molecular‑field ratio, computed by solving the Bethe–Peierls linearized equations for one varying exchange parameter while keeping the other three zero.
Critical biquadratic exchange ratio J1′/J1 at which ferromagnetic order becomes unstable (Tc → 0).

output_contract.notes: The agent must derive the equations from the provided Bethe‑Peierls linearized forms and the coefficient tables. The checker will verify the reported values against independently recomputed hidden references using appropriate tolerances.

steps.description: Recompute kB_Tc_over_J1 and mu1_over_lambda1 from the Bethe-Peierls equations at a selected set of parameter points, then compare with the agent's reported values.
Recompute the critical J1'/J1 ratio where Tc drops to zero and compare with the agent's reported critical_value.
